=== Proof Status ===

1 [[32mvalidated[0m/[32mclean[0m] Mass split: for an exact signed idempotent P and any row index v, writing a_j = P_{vj}, a_j^+ = max(a_j, 0), a_j^- = max(-a_j, 0), and nu_v = sum_j a_j^-, one has sum_j a_j^+ = 1 + nu_v.
  1.1 [[32mvalidated[0m/[32mclean[0m] For each index j, the real number a_j = P_{vj} satisfies a_j = a_j^+ - a_j^-, where a_j^+ = max(a_j, 0) and a_j^- = max(-a_j, 0).
  1.2 [[32mvalidated[0m/[32mclean[0m] Since P is an exact signed idempotent, P 1 = 1, so the row-v entries satisfy sum_j a_j = sum_j P_{vj} = 1.
  1.3 [[32mvalidated[0m/[32mclean[0m] Summing the pointwise decomposition over the finite index set j = 1, ..., n gives sum_j a_j = sum_j a_j^+ - sum_j a_j^-.
  1.4 [[32mvalidated[0m/[32mclean[0m] Combining the two evaluations of sum_j a_j yields sum_j a_j^+ - sum_j a_j^- = 1.
  1.5 [[32mvalidated[0m/[32mclean[0m] By definition nu_v = sum_j a_j^-, hence sum_j a_j^+ - nu_v = 1.
  1.6 [[32mvalidated[0m/[32mclean[0m] Therefore sum_j a_j^+ = 1 + nu_v.
